title: November and December 2026 Long Weekends: Holiday Calendar and Trip Planning
summary: Every holiday in November and December 2026 mapped against the day of the week, with leave strategies, long weekend windows and trip ideas.
body_markdown:
November and December 2026 carry seven gazetted holidays and at least three natural long weekends. Two of those weekends extend to four or five usable days with just one day of leave. The trick is knowing which holiday falls on which day of the week, because that single detail is what separates a regular weekend from a travel window.


This calendar maps every relevant holiday against the day of the week, identifies the leave strategies that create extended breaks, and pairs each window with destination ideas scaled to the available time.


## **Why the Day of the Week Matters More Than the Date**


A Tuesday holiday with Monday leave gives you a four-day weekend. The same holiday on a Wednesday gives you a midweek break that does not extend either way without burning two leave days. The long weekend november december 2026 calendar is unusually favourable because several key holidays fall on Sundays and Tuesdays, creating natural extensions.


# **November and December 2026: Complete Long Weekend Calendar With Trip Ideas**


Every window below includes the holiday date, the day of the week, the leave strategy if any, and what kind of trip fits the available time.


## **November 2026**


### **Diwali Weekend: November 6 to 11**


Diwali falls on Sunday, November 8. Govardhan Puja is Monday, November 9. Bhai Dooj is Wednesday, November 11.


**The window:** If you take Tuesday November 10 off, you get a six-day break from Saturday November 7 through Wednesday November 11. That is the longest Diwali weekend possible in 2026, and it requires only one day of leave.


**Minimum window without leave:** Saturday November 7 to Monday November 9, three days.


**Trip ideas for 3 days:** Agra, Jaipur, Rishikesh, Mathura-Vrindavan. All reachable from Delhi within 4 to 6 hours by bus. The Govardhan Hill parikrama near Mathura on November 9 adds a festival element.


**Trip ideas for 5 to 6 days:** Rajasthan circuit (Jaipur to Jodhpur to Udaipur). Goa (November is the start of the season). Kerala backwaters (post-monsoon, lush and navigable). Kullu Valley (the tail end of the autumn colour window).


### **Chhath Puja: November 15**


The main Chhath Puja day (Sandhya Arghya) falls on Sunday, November 15. The four-day sequence runs November 13 (Friday, Nahay Khay) to November 16 (Monday, Usha Arghya).


**The window:** The Friday-to-Monday sequence naturally creates a four-day weekend without any leave. This is particularly relevant for the Bihar and eastern UP diaspora travelling home from Delhi.


**Trip idea:** For those not observing Chhath, this is a quiet four-day window while much of North India is focused on the festival. Hill stations and Rajasthan destinations see lower crowds during this period.


### **Guru Nanak Jayanti: November 24**


Guru Nanak Jayanti falls on Tuesday, November 24. The same day is Kartik Purnima and Dev Deepawali in Varanasi.


**The window:** Take Monday November 23 off for a four-day break from Saturday November 21 to Tuesday November 24. One day of leave, four days of travel.


**Trip ideas for 4 days:** Amritsar for Gurpurab celebrations at the Golden Temple. Varanasi for Dev Deepawali (the ghats lit with thousands of diyas on Kartik Purnima night). Pushkar for the tail end of the Pushkar Camel Fair, which runs November 17 to 24.


**This is the most versatile long weekend in November.** Three completely different festival experiences fall on the same date, and each connects to a practical bus route from Delhi.


---


## **December 2026**


### **Christmas: December 25**


Christmas falls on Friday, December 25. This creates a three-day weekend (Friday to Sunday) without any leave.


**Trip ideas for 3 days:** Goa (peak Christmas season, midnight mass at Basilica of Bom Jesus, Fontainhas Latin Quarter). Pondicherry (French Quarter Christmas celebrations). Rishikesh (quiet riverside weekend in cold, clear weather).


**Extended option:** Take Monday December 28 off for a four-day window. Or combine with the New Year break for a full week off with just 3 days of leave (December 28, 29, 30).


### **New Year: January 1, 2027**


New Year’s Day is Friday, January 1, 2027. Another natural three-day weekend.


**Trip ideas:** Goa (New Year parties, beach countdown). Jaisalmer (desert camping under clear winter skies). Udaipur (lakeside New Year celebrations). Manali (snow season, bonfire New Year).


### **Combining Christmas and New Year**


If you take December 28, 29 and 30 off (Monday to Wednesday), you get a continuous break from December 25 to January 1, a full nine days of travel with only three days of leave. This is the biggest travel window of the year.


**Trip ideas for 9 days:** A complete Rajasthan circuit (Jaipur, Jodhpur, Jaisalmer, Udaipur). A Kerala tour (Kochi, Munnar, Thekkady, Alleppey, Varkala). A Northeast India trip (Meghalaya, Assam). A Himachal deep dive (Delhi to Manali to Spiti, though road access depends on snowfall by late December).

## **How to Book Smartly**


Festival-adjacent travel dates see fare and accommodation spikes. The Diwali weekend and the Christmas-New Year stretch are the two highest-demand windows of the year for Indian domestic travel.


Book bus tickets 2 to 3 weeks before the Diwali window. For the Christmas-New Year stretch, book by early December. Accommodation in Goa, Jaipur, Udaipur and Manali during these windows must be secured well in advance.


Check current bus schedules and availability on the[Jaipur bus booking page](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/jaipur-bus-booking-online) for the Rajasthan corridor, or the[Delhi to Agra bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-agra-bus-route) for the short Agra weekend.


***Note:*** *Prices are approximate and may vary based on season, demand, and availability.*


## **Common Questions About November-December Long Weekends**


### **How many long weekends are there in November and December 2026?**


November has three natural long weekends (Diwali, Chhath, Guru Nanak Jayanti) and December has two (Christmas, New Year).


### **Which is the longest possible break with minimum leave in late 2026?**


The Christmas-to-New-Year window gives nine continuous days from December 25 to January 1 with only three days of leave.


### **Does Diwali 2026 create a long weekend?**


Diwali falls on Sunday November 8, and with one day of leave on Tuesday November 10 you get a five or six-day window.


### **What day is Guru Nanak Jayanti in 2026?**


Guru Nanak Jayanti is on Tuesday, November 24, creating a four-day weekend with Monday November 23 off.


### **Is the Chhath Puja weekend good for travel?**


The Chhath four-day window from Friday November 13 to Monday November 16 is ideal for destinations that are quieter during the festival.


### **Where should I go for the Christmas 2026 weekend?**


Goa for beach Christmas, Pondicherry for French Quarter celebrations, or Rishikesh for a quiet cold-weather riverside weekend.


### **How early should I book for the New Year travel window?**


Book accommodation and bus tickets by early December for the New Year window, as Goa and Rajasthan destinations fill rapidly.


### **Can I combine Christmas and New Year into one long trip?**


Taking December 28, 29 and 30 off connects Christmas (Dec 25) to New Year (Jan 1) into a nine-day break.


### **What is the best destination for a 4-day Diwali trip from Delhi?**


Jaipur, Udaipur and the Mathura-Vrindavan Govardhan Puja circuit are all reachable by bus and fit a 4-day window.


### **Does November 24 have multiple festivals?**


November 24 carries Guru Nanak Jayanti, Kartik Purnima and Dev Deepawali simultaneously, offering three distinct travel experiences.
